title: HotCRM: translate the 9 step names of opportunity_approval
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35979 (PR #36383, flow step names translate). Filed by the seat. Parent: #35979. Repository: objectstack-ai/hotcrm.

## What happens

Once the `nodes` translation group ships, HotCRM's `opportunity_approval` flow still draws its 9 step names in English for a zh-CN user, and the coverage check will report them.

## To do

1. After the ObjectStack release that carries #36383 and its reader half, add zh-CN (and every locale HotCRM ships) entries for the 9 steps of `opportunity_approval` under `flows.opportunity_approval.nodes.NODE_ID.label`.
2. Run HotCRM's translation coverage check.

## Acceptance

- The approval flow viewer in HotCRM, zh-CN, shows no English step name.

Blocked-by: #36383

## Grade
p2 · area:i18n. A visible English string on a demo-app flow for every zh-CN user.
